'''R-C92''' was a model of [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] that was stationed on the [[Makeb orbital station|Imperial Orbital Station]] orbiting the planet [[Makeb]]. The droid assisted [[Darth Marr]] in enlisting the help of the Imperial strike team during the time of the [[Conquest of Makeb]].<ref name="TOR" />
